subject: Vendor onboarding: insurance timing, PO queueing and next steps
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@clearpath.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: COI & PO timing for ClearPath onboarding

Hi Priyom / Monica,

Thanks again — we're excited to get ClearPath integrated with Redwood's Hosted API. Attached are the initial certificate of insurance and our latest SOW for the connector work (files: clearpath_coi_20261107.pdf, clearpath_sow_v2.docx). A few quick notes/questions: 

- The COI lists general liability limits at $1M / $2M AS AGG. We can request an endorsement to name Redwood Inference as Additional Insured but that takes the insurer 3–5 business days.
- Do you need specific endorsement language (e.g., waiver of subrogation) or is "Redwood Inference, its officers, employees and agents" acceptable?
- We're ready to start work but procurement told us PO issuance is queued until endorsement/COI is confirmed — any flexibility for a conditional PO?

Attached: clearpath_coi_20261107.pdf (pdf), clearpath_sow_v2.docx (docx). Also attached W9 on company portal.

Would appreciate confirmation of what will allow a conditional PO (short list of acceptable artifacts).

Best,
Sophie Lang
Sr. Ops Lead, ClearPath AI
sophie.lang@clearpath.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: COI & PO timing for ClearPath onboarding

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of asks so Procurement & Risk can move forward: 

- We do require Redwood Inference to be named as Additional Insured on the policy with a standard primary/waiver of subrogation endorsement where possible. The exact name to include is: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents."
- If insurer cannot provide the endorsement immediately, we can accept the COI plus a broker confirmation email that the endorsement is in process (and ETA). That typically lets Procurement issue a conditional PO with a 14-day conditional period.
- Please also send your Tax ID / W9 and a point of contact for invoicing.

I'll loop Karthik on PO timing — Karthik, if we get broker confirmation today and endorsement within 5 business days, can Procurement move ClearPath into the PO queue with a conditional note?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Ops / Procurement
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@clearpath.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-08T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: COI & PO timing for ClearPath onboarding

Hi Priyom,

Attached are the updated documents: we've requested the additional insured endorsement and included our broker's acknowledgement (broker_ack_clearpath.pdf). The insurer estimates 3 business days to issue the endorsement. For now we can provide the brokerage confirmation email as interim evidence. Also attaching: clearpath_sow_v2.docx and a scanned W9.

Attachment stubs: clearpath_coi_20261107.pdf, clearpath_sow_v2.docx, broker_ack_clearpath.pdf, clearpath_w9.pdf

Quick answers:
- The brokerage note confirms they will add: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents" as Additional Insured.
- We can accept a conditional PO for invoicing against milestone 1 (onboarding kickoff) while endorsement processes.

Let us know what other paperwork Procurement needs to queue the PO.

Regards,
Sophie

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: COI & PO timing for ClearPath onboarding

Thanks, Sophie — the broker acknowledgement and W9 are sufficient to create a conditional PO in our system. Summary of next steps (we'll track in PROC-2018):

1) Procurement (Karthik) will queue a conditional PO for milestone 1 with a 14-day condition that the formal endorsement is uploaded to our vendor portal.
2) Risk (Monica) will review the endorsement when issued; if there are material changes to policy limits or endorsement scope, Risk will follow up within 48 hours.
3) ClearPath may begin onboarding tasks for the kickoff milestone but Redwood will not accept invoices for milestone 2+ until endorsement is confirmed.

Karthik — please create the PO in the queue and tag it with deal CPAI-0421 and link to PROC-2018. Monica — let me know if the insurer's endorsement text (when posted) requires any comment.

Sophie — please forward the endorsement as soon as it's available. We'll share the conditional PO number once created.

Thanks all,
Priyom Das
Vendor Ops / Procurement
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

--
Internal notes: PO creation checklist: vendor legal name, remit address, W9 attached, COI on file, broker acknowledgement uploaded, conditional note added.
